item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Bottle on a Kitchen Counter

turns.text: Put this bottle on a light stone kitchen counter, with a tidy modern kitchen behind it. Keep the bottle exactly as it is. Square photo, no text.

item.tests: Tests replacing a product photo's setting while preserving the actual product and making its placement believable.

answer_sheet.Which product: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.New background and style: A photorealistic tidy modern kitchen with a light stone counter; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Product changes: Keep the bottle's shape, matte black finish and visible details unchanged.
answer_sheet.Size and text: One square image at the standard free size, with no added text.

must_haves: The same matte black bottle is recognizable, with its shape and visible details preserved.
The bottle stands on a light stone kitchen counter rather than the original wooden table.
A tidy modern kitchen is visible behind the bottle.
The bottle has clean edges and a believable contact shadow, without appearing to float.
The output is square and has no added text.

turns.text: Could you take the bottle in this pic and put it on a light stone kitchen counter? I’ve been trying to picture it in a kitchen setting, and I’m a little worried it could end up looking out of place. I want a square photo, with no text. Please have a tidy modern kitchen behind it. Keep the bottle exactly as it is.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the kitchen photo. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so the edit was refused and nothing was created.

The edit I tried used the cheapest image option on your plan, which costs about 5 credits for one picture. A cheaper setting won't fix this.

**To go ahead:** add credits to your Magic Hour account or wait for your free credits to refresh, then let me know and I'll run it again. The settings will be the same:
- Your bottle, kept as it is (same shape, matte black finish and cap)
- Standing on a light stone counter, with a tidy modern kitchen softly out of focus behind it
- Square photo with no text, labels or logos
- A soft shadow under the bottle and matching light, so it looks like it belongs there

The editing tool redraws the whole picture, so small details on the bottle might change slightly. I'll compare the result with your original before I send it to you.
